title: Farmer's Square Deal Cooperative Grain Elevator, Liberty & Division Streets, Morris, Grundy County, IL
notes: Significance: The fireproof grain elevator built for the Farmer's Square Deal Cooperative is an early example of reinforced concrete construction.
